preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 10^5 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only small Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of parts of the password.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= len(input_string) for xi in x_values)
postconditions.description: The starting position of each part is between 1 and the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= len(input_string) for li in l_values)
postconditions.description: The length of each part is positive and does not exceed the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(li % 2 == 1 for li in l_values if xi == x_values[0])
postconditions.description: The length of the middle part is odd.

postconditions.expression: sum(li for xi, li in zip(x_values, l_values)) == len(input_string)
postconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all parts equals the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(input_string[xi-1:xi-1+li] == input_string[len(input_string)-xi-li+1:len(input_string)-xi+1] for xi, li in zip(x_values, l_values))
postconditions.description: Each part of the password is a palindrome of odd length.
